textContent:
During Pioneer Podcast, you can obtain Podcast EXP by completing Podcast Tasks to increase the Podcast level and win various rewards.
 
✦Duration✦
Version 3.7 update - 2026-11-11 03:59 (server time)
 
✦Rewards✦
● The Public Channel is unlocked by default during the Pioneer Podcast event.
- Increase your Podcast Level to obtain Lustrous Tide x5, Modifier x6, Crystal Solvent x5, and other Materials.
 
● You can purchase and unlock the Insider Channel or Connoisseur Channel.
- Increase your Podcast Level to additionally obtain Astrite x680, Radiant Tide x5, Lustrous Tide x2, Modifier x24, Pioneer Podcast Supply Pack Ⅱ x1, Crystal Solvent x7, and other Materials.
- Purchase and unlock the Connoisseur Channel to immediately increase your Podcast Level by 10 and obtain Version Exclusive Sigil: Heart's Nature, Lustrous Tide x3, Modifier x10, and Pioneer Podcast Syntonization Chest x1.
 
※Open a Pioneer Podcast Supply Pack Ⅱ to claim one Golden Eternal or Hunter's Growl series weapon of your choice, or Premium Tuner x200.
※Open a Pioneer Podcast Syntonization Chest to obtain one Syntonization material of your choice, from either the Hunter's Growl series or Golden Eternal series, and use it to increase the Syntonization Rank of a Hunter's Growl or Golden Eternal weapon.
 
✦Eligibility✦
Reach Union Level 9.
 
✦Event Details✦
- Podcast Tasks include the Morning Broadcasts, Weekly Highlights, and Seasonal Specials. Podcast Tasks refresh at different times.
- There is a weekly limit to the amount of EXP obtainable from Podcast Tasks, which includes EXP obtained from the Morning Broadcasts and Weekly Highlights. You will be unable to obtain more EXP upon reaching the limit.
- During Pioneer Podcast, your Podcast Level cannot be increased beyond the maximum limit.
-After the Pioneer Podcast event ends, if you have any claimable rewards that were not claimed, these rewards will be distributed via mail.
※If you happen to repeatedly activate the Channel (such as the Insider Channel, the Connoisseur Channel, or upgrading the Insider Channel to the Connoisseur Channel), rewards will not be repeatedly distributed and Lunites of equivalent value will be directly refunded.
 
※For more details, please refer to the Pioneer Podcast page.
